notes.title: New Homebody Update!
notes.content:
Hi homebodies,

It's been a while, here's a new patch! Some bugfixes and some much-requested changes are included here, including proper support for resolutions above 1920x1080.

We remain very grateful for the response to the game and we're touched/sorry it has connected with people and wanted to thank you all for your support!

[h3]Relatedly: We just hit 500 reviews, but let's get to 1000! Please tell your friends and leave a review on Steam if you feel like it![/h3]

Here's the full changelog:

- Small UI/UX improvements.
- Improved high resolution support: the game now supports resolutions higher than 1920x1080. Though the rendering resolution is the same as before to keep the same pixel vibe, the graphics are scaled internally to keep graphics and UI elements crisp.
- Fixes for dialogue sequencing issues.
	- It was sometimes possible to see dialogue that didn't correctly reflect the current narrative state.
	- Improvements to sequencing and triggering of Pete's puzzle clues. Fixed a few states where clues would be shown out of sequence or after their corresponding puzzle was solved.
- Small visual improvements and fixes to various locations and environments.
	- A few small art changes have been made to improve puzzle clarity and environment detail.

Thanks, take care, be good,
Jory and the Homebody team

notes.title: New Patch, New Art, New Sale!
notes.content:
Hello Homebodies,

It's patch time! We've continued to work away behind the scenes making improvements and squashing bugs.

PATCH NOTES:
[list]
[*] Added a short new cutscene segment to the intro title sequence.
[*] The Memory Log now highlights images that are new information that hasn't been viewed yet, making it clearer when there is a new hint or important information.
[*] Killer AI has been tweaked to be slightly more aggressive, especially later on in the night.
[*] Tweaks and changes to various puzzle elements to improve clarity.
[*] Bug fixes and improvements to hints: Pete should now be less pushy with hints that give away puzzle details, and sequencing changes should make the timing of his hints more useful than ever.
[*] Small improvements to movement with analog (non-Tank) controls.
[*] Various dialogue bug fixes and minor writing consistency fixes.
[*] Some minor visual changes and bug fixes.
[/list]
Anyone notice a little art update too? 👀 We had to get our full horror movie poster vibes going and updated the key art with a brand-new original illustration.

For anyone thinking about grabbing the game or suggesting it to a friend, heads up that Homebody is 50% off this week through September 11!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959350/Homebody/

Keep the feedback, comments, and reviews coming and don't forget to look behind you... 🔪

- Jory and The Game Grumps Team

notes.title: New Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Hello Homebodies,

It’s been a crazy but super exciting month since launch! We can’t believe it’s already summer. With puzzles, spooks, and a deep story, we think Homebody is a great choice for a summer weekend playthrough. 

Reviews are still rolling in and we’re thrilled to see what folks think about the game.

[previewyoutube=o7TAo8xU1Vc;full][/previewyoutube]

And we’re continuing to make it even better for all of you! We submitted one patch already but patch number two is going out today as well.

[u][b]Patch 2 Notes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added Tank Controls option to Gameplay menu, enabling (even more) retro-style character control: pressing left and right makes Emily turn left or right, respectively, and pressing up or down makes Emily walk forwards or backwards, respectively. More like some of the classic games we were inspired by! By default, this is enabled on the D-Pad when using a controller, but you can adjust settings to disable this or enable Tank controls on the keyboard as well.
[*] Time display reworked to always be shown and display a pause button when time is paused during conversations, reading books, etc.
[*] Adjustments to camera angles and camera triggers to improve flow. Now Emily should get turned around a little less.
[*] Some adjustments to hint system flow, sequencing, and clarity. This should quiet down "Backseat Pete" just a bit.
[*] Changes to flow and pacing of dialogue in cutscenes and in early-game conversations with the other kids.
[/list]

Keep the feedback, comments, and reviews coming and keep an eye out for that killer… 🔪

- Jory and The Game Grumps Team

notes.title: Homebody Cloud Save and 1st Patch
notes.content:
Hello Homebodies, 

It's been 2 weeks since launch and we hope you've been enjoying the house of puzzles ...and being murdered over and over again. We have gotten an overwhelming amount of love from both the community and the creators - mostly for Gary...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433153/622b311b68859b317089bbd47547be827ab64809.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for your continued support, we have already put your initial feedback to action in our first patch - live now!

Here's what you should expect to see: 

[b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b]
The game now supports syncing of save progress through Steam Cloud. Be sure to update the game on all your devices to take advantage of this feature.

[b]AI Fixes for the Killer[/b]
The killer should now be more aggressive in pursuing multiple targets and will open closets more appropriately. Cases where the Killer would stand still when facing multiple targets, or would freeze when preparing to open a closet that the player is hiding in, should be fixed.
 
[b]Audio Fixes[/b]
Minor audio bugs have been fixed. In particular, Emily's scared breathing should now be quieter while hiding in closets.

[b]Dialogue Bug Fixes[/b]
Some of Gary's dialogue lines were being shown repeatedly, and some puzzle-related dialogue from Megan was not being shown appropriately. Known cases have been fixed and further fixes will follow.
 
[b]Hint System Updates and Fixes[/b]
Several hints shown between loops should now be shown in more useful order (some will show earlier as needed, and some will now stop showing inappropriately early.)
 
[b]Miscellaneous Bug Fixes[/b]
A potential crash bug related to the Memory Log has been fixed. Some small animation issues with NPCs have been fixed

Keep the feedback coming as you play! We are always looking for more ways to improve the game. 
Stay tuned for more!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959350/Homebody/
